meta.name: folklang
meta.note: builtin-programs/ was called virtual-programs/ in earlier folk revisions; the stdlib vocabulary below is the same lineage.

BARE-CHAR.description: any char legal in a bare Tcl word

QUOTE-CHAR.description: any char inside double quotes except " \ $ [

rules.name: folk-script
rules.description: A folk program: a sequence of commands (this is a Tcl script)

rules.name: command
rules.description: One command: words separated by whitespace, ended by newline or ;

rules.name: comment
rules.description: Comment: # at command position through end of line

rules.name: word
rules.description: A Tcl word; braces are raw, quotes and bare words substitute

rules.name: braced-word
rules.description: Brace-quoted word: no substitution, braces must balance

rules.name: quoted-word
rules.description: Double-quoted word: $var, [cmd], and backslash substitution apply

rules.name: bare-word
rules.description: Unquoted word: ends at whitespace; substitutions apply

rules.name: substitution
rules.description: Runtime substitution inside quoted/bare words

rules.name: variable-sub
rules.description: Variable substitution

rules.name: command-sub
rules.description: Command substitution: evaluates a nested script

rules.name: backslash-sub
rules.description: Backslash escape (\n, \t, \\, \<newline> line-continuation, ...)

rules.name: body
rules.description: A code block argument: a braced word whose content is a folk-script. Lexical environment is captured around it (captureEnvStack) unless -noncapturing is given on the enclosing form

rules.name: folk-form
rules.description: Any folk reactive form (all are ordinary commands to the host)

rules.name: claim-form
rules.description: Assert a fact on behalf of $this: (this claims <clause>)

rules.name: wish-form
rules.description: Declare a desire on behalf of $this: (this wishes <clause>)

rules.name: say-form
rules.description: Assert a raw statement (subject and verb explicit)

rules.name: statement-modifier
rules.description: Modifiers accepted by Say / Claim / Wish

rules.name: when-form
rules.description: React to matching statements; body reruns per match

rules.name: when-modifier
rules.description: Modifiers accepted by When

rules.name: hold-form
rules.description: Hold a statement (or a when-body) stably across program re-runs. Clause may use Claim/Wish sugar; a lone body holds a when-block

rules.name: hold-modifier
rules.description: Modifiers accepted by Hold!

rules.name: on-unmatch-form
rules.description: Destructor: runs when the enclosing When's match is retracted

rules.name: subscribe-form
rules.description: Subscribe to matches outside the reactive graph (advanced)

rules.name: notify-form
rules.description: Fire-and-forget notification statement (e.g. save requests)

rules.name: query-form
rules.description: Synchronous sampling query; returns list of binding dicts

rules.name: query-one-form
rules.description: Query expecting exactly one result (error otherwise)

rules.name: expect-form
rules.description: QueryOne! that binds results directly into caller scope

rules.name: foreach-form
rules.description: Iterate a query's results, binding each result dict in body

rules.name: fn-form
rules.description: Define/capture a lexically-scoped function shareable through statements

rules.name: arg-list
rules.description: Function argument names, as a Tcl list word

rules.name: assert-form
rules.description: Runtime assertion of a Tcl expr condition

rules.name: duration
rules.description: Duration literal, e.g. 50ms (microseconds appear as N us in options)

rules.name: join-pattern
rules.description: One or more patterns joined with &; later ones see earlier bindings

rules.name: pattern
rules.description: A statement pattern: a sequence of terms matched word-by-word

rules.name: pattern-term
rules.description: One term of a pattern

rules.name: match-variable
rules.description: Slash-delimited variable/wildcard/negation term

rules.name: variable-name
rules.description: Capture name, rest-capture, wildcard, or negation word

rules.name: wildcard-name
rules.description: Matches any single term without binding it

rules.name: negation-name
rules.description: Negates the whole pattern: match when nothing matches

rules.name: bound-reference
rules.description: Reference to a binding from an earlier joined pattern (or scope)

rules.name: statement
rules.description: A normalized database statement

rules.name: subject
rules.description: Who is speaking: a program/page id (usually $this) or node

rules.name: clause
rules.description: The content of a claim/wish; conventional shapes below

rules.name: has-clause
rules.description: Attribute shape: <entity> has <attribute...> <value> ?with-options?

rules.name: is-clause
rules.description: Classification/decoration shape: <entity> is <description...>

rules.name: does-clause
rules.description: Action shape: <entity> <verb> <complement...> (draws, displays, points, runs...)

rules.name: entity
rules.description: The thing spoken about: page id, tag id, camera path, node, ...

rules.name: with-options
rules.description: Keyword-options tail: with key value key value ... ; a rest variable /...options/ conventionally captures it as a dict

rules.name: option-key
rules.description: Option name (color, scale, width, height, layer, font, filled, ...)

rules.name: option-value
rules.description: Option value: any single word

vocabulary.description: Draw an outline around a page/region; 'thick' prefix variant exists
Render text label on a page (options: font, size, color, position)
Title above a page
Fill a page's region with translucent color
Solid fill of a page's quad
Allocate a GPU canvas for a page (options: width, height, layer, settle)
Canvas allocation result; canvas projection claimed alongside
Draw a named shape (circle, arc, ...; options: color, filled, radius...)
Filled/stroked polygon in page coordinates
Open polyline / curve

vocabulary.pattern: /p/ draws a line from /a/ to /b/ with-options?
vocabulary.description: Line segment (dashed variant in draw/dashed-line.folk)
Point cloud
Raw text drawing (label is the higher-level form)
Shadertoy-style fragment shader on a page quad
Compile a custom GPU pipeline (also: compiles function; creates canvas; loads image as texture)
Blit an image value onto a page (options: scale, width, x, y)
JPEG codec registered as an image loader fn
PNG codec registered as an image loader fn
Animated GIF playback on a page (gif-lib.folk decodes frames)

vocabulary.pattern: /p/ draws sprite /path/ with /n/ frames and /m/ columns
vocabulary.description: Sprite-sheet animation
Crop of the camera image under a page's quad, claimed back as (has camera slice /slice/)
Show a captured slice on a page
Camera frames (also: gray frame, jpeg frame, width/height claims)
Enable a camera on this node
Display enumeration; display /d/ has width/height claims follow
AprilTag detections (tag ... is a tag, tag ... has a program follow)
Physical pose of a page as a quad; also (has region /r/), (has resolved geometry /g/)
Spatial pointing relation between pages (variant: with length /l/)
Ask for a pointing whisker of a given length
Compute adjacent pages; claims (has neighbor /p2/)

vocabulary.pattern: a calibration from camera /camera/ to display /display/ is /calibration/
vocabulary.description: Camera->display homography; intrinsics/extrinsics claims alongside
Draw a connecting line between two pages (dynamic variant exists)
Image contours of a page's slice; SAM2/CRAFT/TrOCR loaders adjacent

vocabulary.pattern: /k/ is a keyboard with path /path/ locale /locale/
vocabulary.description: Keyboard devices; (/k/ is typing into /program/), (has keyboard input)
Per-frame clock claim driving animation (auto-atomically in When)

vocabulary.pattern: to collect results for /pattern/ with settle /settle/
vocabulary.description: Aggregate: claims (the collected results for /pattern/ are /results/)
Spawn a process; claims (has Unix output lines /lines/), (has Unix error output /e/)
Runtime errors surface as statements; errors.folk renders them
Program source as data; editor/print pipeline consumes it
On-table editor pages

vocabulary.pattern: printer /name/ is a cups printer with /...options/
vocabulary.description: Printing programs onto paper (esc-pos.folk for receipt printers)
Interactive terminal on a page
Audio playback / music.folk sequencing
Web dashboard: browser-based editing, db inspection, camera views

features.title: Core syntax
features.description: Layers 0-2: reader, Claim/Wish/When/Hold!/On unmatch, patterns, joins, negation, rest-vars

features.title: Reactive DB
features.description: Statement trie, incremental match/unmatch, destructors, -keep expiry, atomically

features.title: 2D drawing
features.description: shapes, polygons, polylines, lines, points, text

features.title: Video
features.description: video file / stream playback (no builtin upstream; folkOS extension)

features.title: AprilTags
features.description: tag detection claims (simulators: virtual tag poses)

features.title: Page geometry
features.description: quads, regions, resolved geometry, points-at, neighbors

features.title: Clock/animation
features.description: the clock time is /t/ frame driver

features.title: Program mgmt
features.description: program code claims, saving, groups, demos

renderers.title: Folk native (Vulkan)
renderers.notes: Upstream reference implementation; baseline for conformance. Video not built in.

renderers.title: folkOS Vulkan clone
renderers.notes: Clone + refine of upstream pipeline; parity target.

renderers.title: JS simulator (headless CLI)
renderers.notes: Engine-first target: reader + reactive db + synthetic claims; renders nothing, asserts everything.

renderers.title: WASM simulator
renderers.notes: Shared core for browser targets; no subprocess spawning in-sandbox.

renderers.title: C++ simulator (CLI)
renderers.notes: Native engine; substrate for SDL/Metal/Vulkan frontends.

renderers.title: CLI ASCII emulation
renderers.notes: Everything visual degrades to cells: outlines are box-drawing, images are half-block mosaics.

renderers.title: Linux SDL renderer
renderers.notes: Software/GL 2D path; gpu-shader partial (translate toy shaders to GLSL).

renderers.title: JS <canvas> 2D
renderers.notes: Browser codecs are free (jpeg/png via Image, video via <video>); shaders unsupported.

renderers.title: JS+WASM <canvas>
renderers.notes: Same surface as render-js-canvas with the WASM engine core.

renderers.title: JS WebGPU <canvas>
renderers.notes: Closest browser analog to upstream's Vulkan path; toy shaders retargeted to WGSL.

renderers.title: Metal renderer (macOS)
renderers.notes: MSL retarget of shader surface; AVFoundation for camera/video.

renderers.title: Metal renderer (iOS)
renderers.notes: Touch-first; no subprocesses; camera is the device camera.
